title: Questions
description: Questions and answers that open and close, with the heading on the left. They work with the keyboard and without JavaScript.

title.default:
What people ask
at the first visit.

default.question: Do I need planning permission?
default.answer: Most rear extensions and dormer lofts fall under permitted development, so you don’t. If yours doesn’t, or you’re in a conservation area, we tell you at the first visit and handle the application with the architect.

default.question: Can we stay in the house during the work?
default.answer: On most extensions and lofts, yes. We set up a temporary kitchen if you need one and seal off the work area. Basements and whole-house jobs usually mean moving out for part of the build.

default.question: What isn’t included in the fixed price?
default.answer: Architect fees, loose furniture and appliances you choose yourself. Anything we can’t see until we open up, like what’s behind a wall, goes in as a separate line with a ceiling. Priya can’t stand open-ended provisional sums, so ours always have a maximum.

default.question: How soon can you start?
default.answer: We’re booking starts for March 2027. Surveys and design can begin now, so you’re ready when your slot comes up.

default.question: Do you work outside north and east London?
default.answer: We work within about five miles of our yard in N1: Islington, Hackney, Camden, Haringey and Tower Hamlets. It’s how your site manager can be with you in 20 minutes.
